significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling: during false-belief role-play, the measurable "shift of the own-belief representation toward the false persona value" predicts later "own-voice factual leakage," alongside a form-(ii) result that a "belief-ownership" intervention causally reduces that leakage while preserving role-play. This would establish both a temporally persistent phenomenon and a mechanism, constraining explanations of post-role-play errors toward persona-induced representational contamination rather than mere simultaneous self/other decodability; this matters to the interpretive use of self/other belief representations exemplified by Language Models Represent Beliefs of Self and Others. The claim is determinate, and its negative branch—"no excess over the no-persona control" and no contamination-error coupling—would specifically favor instruction or discourse carryover over corruption of an own-belief state, rather than merely reporting failure to find a probe. In the topic-substitution check, generic research on LLM beliefs would not itself imply this delayed predictive coupling or causal insulation, so the score is supported by claim-specific content rather than the topic's importance.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "contamination score" as a predictor, the "belief-ownership" steering direction as an intervention, and the released "persona-vs-self false-belief benchmark"; the first two could be used by downstream auditors or deployers rather than only by researchers describing representations. The predictor and intervention are ex ante with respect to the own-voice error: contamination is measured during role-play to predict "factual errors after role-play," leaving an action window in which insulation or gating can be applied. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive prediction survives as a relation—greater contamination should forecast greater leakage—although the particular steering vector and numerical calibration need rediscovery; the asserted scope spans "fact domains, persona types, jailbreak personas, and multi-turn role-play" and targets customer-support and educational deployments. In the topic-substitution check, the beliefs topic alone supplies neither this advance-warning metric nor a deployment-time insulation knob, so the above-median reach comes from the specific conclusion.
